text_block_list.text:
At last, the Japan Cup is here. We arrive
at the
track in the morning, focused and
ready.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ah... Грасс Вандер and her trainer!
Good
morning!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text:
Oh, good morning. Have you come to
watch my
race once again?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Of course! I wouldn't dream of missing
the Beast's
Successor!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text:
Oh! That reminds me! Have you two seen
the
article everyone's been talking
about online?
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text: Which one, if I may ask?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
After a few quick taps, the reporter
holds up a
screen to show a news site
known for its Arima
Kinen predictions.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Everyone knows the Arima Kinen is one
of the
biggest races—only the best
classic and senior
year Umamusume are
voted in!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text:
Take a look at their predictions on who
will run
this year!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text: Oh, my...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Both Maruzen and myself are on this list.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Грасс Вандер has spent her classic year
building
up experience specifically to
challenge
Марузенски.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
This might be Grass's big chance to race
her!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Марузенски and I, on the same track at the Arima Kinen... Hehe, that would be an honor.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It's because of Марузенски that
you've
been gathering so much
attention! Personally, I
can't wait!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text:
Of course, I'm excited to see how you do
today,
as well! Do your best out there!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text: ...It's almost time.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Yes. Let's be on our way.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Grass!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
If it isn't El. Did you come here to get
me?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Sí, sí! I've come to be your guide!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: I've got a race to win here, and it's gonna be flashy! Grrrass Wonder, enter the riiiiing!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, the ring? Are you sure we're going
to the
same place?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I'm headed to the track, to take the title
of
"Beast's Successor"...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: And leave it in the dust.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Leave it, eh?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Whatever you say! Now c'mon, Grass! To
the
paddock!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Yes. Trainer, I should be off.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
